item.mng: γurban yirtinčü-yi teyin büged ilaγuγči yeke onol-un qaγan
item.coloph: töbed-ün rma rinčhen mčhog kelemürči ber orčiγulbai

item.mng: γurban yirtinčü-yi / teyin büged ilaγuγči, yeke onol-un qaγan,
item.coloph: endkeg-ün ubadini sanding garba kiged, kelemüči deu-a ja-a-y-a / kṣita orčiγulbai. , . su-a bar hid bhavantu. , . / dai erketü kümün-ü eǰen delekei-tekin-ü qormusta-yin ǰarliγ-iyar samdan sengge töbed-ün kelen-eče mongγol-un ayalγun-dur orčiγuluγad / nayiraγulǰu orosiγulbai. , . maṃ gha-a la-aṃ.
